atoms.a: My grandmother’s banana bread recipe contains several secret ingredients. The three main ingredients, however, weigh a total of 620 grams. That is made up of <mat>20%</mat> butter, <mat>35%</mat> sugar and <mat>45%</mat> flour. How many grams of butter do you need to bake the banana bread?

Once my grandmother has added all the secret ingredients, she bakes the dough for <mat>60</mat> min. Importantly, after <mat>85%</mat> of the time, she reduces the heat from 180 °C to 160 °C, so the crust doesn’t burn. After how many minutes do you have to reduce the heat?
atoms.sound: Once my grandmother has added all the secret ingredients, she bakes the dough for 60min. Importantly, after 85% of the time, she reduces the heat from 180 degrees Celsius to 160 degrees Celsius, so the crust doesn’t burn. After how many minutes do you have to reduce the heat?
atoms.b: You have to reduce the heat after ((48min ++51min 54min)).

atoms.a: Since everyone wants to have a piece of banana bread, my grandmother cuts it into several slices. Each slice is <mat>5%</mat> of the whole banana bread. How many slices are there?
atoms.b: There are a total of ((25 ++20 15)) slices.

atoms.a: Darius works in the kitchen of a restaurant. Every day the restaurant uses <mat>1200</mat> pieces of cutlery. Darius has already washed <mat>40%</mat> of the cutlery. How many pieces of cutlery are still dirty?

Once he is done with the cutlery, he needs to wash <mat>600</mat> dirty plates. <mat>80%</mat> of the plates fit into the kitchen’s enormous industrial dishwasher, but the rest must be washed by hand. How many plates must he wash by hand?
atoms.b: He must wash ((480 ++120 310)) plates by hand.

atoms.a: Finally, he has to wash the glasses. He already washed <mat>1200</mat> pieces of cutlery and <mat>600</mat> plates. Many guests came only for drinks, so there are as many glasses as <mat>90%</mat> of the already-washed pieces of cutlery and plates. How many dirty glasses does Darius have to wash?
atoms.b: Darius has to wash ((1,600 ++1,620 1,640)) dirty glasses.
